blocks.text: Fe'lni takrorlamaslik: I am, I don't

O'zbek tilida savolga javob berganda yoki ikki kishini taqqoslaganda fe'lni qayta aytamiz: «Choy ichasizmi? — Ha, **ichaman**.», «Men go'sht yemayman, ukam esa **yeydi**.» Ingliz tilida esa butun fe'l birikmasi qaytarilmaydi — uning o'rnida faqat **yordamchi fe'l** qoladi: Do you drink tea? — Yes, I **do**. I don't eat meat, but my brother **does**. Bu yordamchi fe'l o'ziga xos «o'rinbosar»: u gapning zamonini va egasini saqlaydi, qolgan qismi esa suhbatdoshga allaqachon ma'lum.

Nega shunchaki «Yes.» yoki «No.» demaslik kerak? Yolg'iz Yes / No xato emas, lekin quruq, ba'zan qo'pol eshitiladi. Inglizlar deyarli doim qisqa javob beradi: Yes, I am. / No, she doesn't. Asosiy fe'lni takrorlash esa («Yes, I drink tea.») ortiqcha va g'ayritabiiy: tinglovchi nima haqida gap ketayotganini savoldan biladi.

Qoida bitta: **savolda yoki gapning birinchi qismida qaysi yordamchi fe'l bo'lsa, qisqa javobda ham o'sha keladi**. be (am/is/are, was/were), have/has (Present Perfect), can, will, should, might, must — o'zi qaytariladi. Agar gapda yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmasa (Present Simple va Past Simple darak gapi: I like, she works, they went), uning o'rnini **do / does / did** egallaydi. Yordamchi fe'llar haqida batafsil — → 23-dars (be / have / do).

rows: Do you like jazz? Does he work?

items.text: Is the bank open now? — Yes, **it is**.
Does your father work on Saturdays? — No, **he doesn't**.
Have you ever tried Uzbek bread? — Yes, **I have**.
items.translation: O'zbek nonini hech tatib ko'rganmisiz? — Ha, **tatib ko'rganman**.

items.text: Can you hear me? — Yes, **I can**.

blocks.text: Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, I don't.

Qisqa javob tuzilishi: **Yes / No + olmosh + yordamchi fe'l** (inkorda `n't` qo'shiladi). Savoldagi ot javobda olmoshga aylanadi: Is **your sister** married? — Yes, **she** is. Does **the hotel** have a pool? — No, **it** doesn't. **you** bilan so'ralsa, javob **I** yoki **we** bilan beriladi: Are you busy? — Yes, **I** am. Are you and Tom free tonight? — Yes, **we** are.

Darak qisqa javobda fe'l **qisqartirilmaydi**: Are you ready? — Yes, I **am**. («Yes, I'm.» — xato). Is she at home? — Yes, she **is**. («Yes, she's.» — xato). Sababi: gap oxiridagi yordamchi fe'l urg'u oladi, qisqa shakl esa urg'usiz bo'ladi. Inkorda qisqa shakl odatiy: No, I**'m not**. / No, she **isn't**.
Taqqoslash: I'm not, but my sister is

Xuddi shu usul ikki kishi yoki narsani taqqoslashda ishlatiladi. Gapning birinchi qismi to'liq, ikkinchi qismida faqat ega va yordamchi fe'l qoladi. Ko'pincha **but** bilan bog'lanadi va qismlardan biri darak, ikkinchisi inkor bo'ladi. O'zbekchada bu vazifani ko'pincha **esa** yuklamasi bajaradi: Men charchamadim, Madina **esa** charchadi — I'm not tired, but Madina **is**.

items.text: I'm not a morning person, but my wife **is**.
items.translation: Men erta turadiganlardan emasman, xotinim esa **shunday**.

items.text: Aziz likes football, but his brother **doesn't**.
We didn't watch the news, but our neighbours **did**.
I haven't been to Oxford, but Emma **has**.

blocks.text: Ikkinchi qismni to'liq aytish ham mumkin («..., but Aziz is tired»), lekin bu takrordek eshitiladi; qisqa shakl tabiiyroq. E'tibor bering: ikkinchi qismdagi yordamchi fe'l birinchi qismning **zamoniga** mos keladi: Sarah **likes** jazz, but I **don't**. Sarah **liked** the film, but I **didn't**. Ega o'zgarsa, shakl ham o'zgaradi: I don't, but she **does**.

rows: Men mashina hayday olmayman, xotinim esa hayday oladi.
Tom uyda, Emma esa uyda emas.
U shanba kunlari ishlaydi, men esa ishlamayman.
Ular qo'ng'iroq qilmadi, siz esa qildingiz.
Men tugatdim, Bekzod esa hali tugatmadi.
Bugun yomg'ir yog'maydi, ertaga esa yog'adi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Do you like tea? — Yes, I like.» → **Yes, I do.** (like to'ldiruvchisiz yolg'iz qolmaydi); «Are you hungry? — Yes, I do.» → **Yes, I am.** (savolda are — javobda ham be); «I don't like coffee, but my brother likes.» → **..., but my brother does.**; «She can't swim, but I can swim.» — xato emas, lekin ortiqcha: **..., but I can.**
Modal fe'llar: can, will, might, should

Modal fe'llar (can, could, will, should, might, must) ham o'zi qaytariladi: Can you ski? — No, I **can't**. Javobda savoldagidan boshqa modal ham kelishi mumkin — u javobning ma'nosini aniqlaydi: Are you coming tomorrow? — I **might** (balki kelarman), I **should** (kelishim kerak), I **can't** (kela olmayman). Present Perfect da — have / has: Has Tom called? — No, he **hasn't**.

items.text: Will you be at the party? — **I might**, if I finish work early.
items.translation: Ziyofatda bo'lasizmi? — Ishni erta tugatsam, **bo'lishim mumkin**.

items.text: Could you open the window? — Sorry, **I can't**. It's stuck.
items.translation: Derazani ochib bera olasizmi? — Kechirasiz, **ocha olmayman**, qotib qolgan.

items.text: Has the film started? — Yes, **it has**. Hurry up!

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: javobni savolning boshidan oling. **Are** you ...? → I **am**. **Did** she ...? → she **did**. **Can** they ...? → they **can**. Savolning birinchi so'zi — qisqa javobning oxirgi so'zi.

Bu qolip keyingi darslarda ham kerak bo'ladi: qiziqish bildiruvchi qayta so'roq (Are you? Do you?) va tasdiq so'roqlari (It's nice, isn't it?) — → 41-dars; boshqa kishiga qo'shilish (So am I. Neither do I.) — → 42-dars.

items: Savolga javob berganda va taqqoslaganda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi — faqat **yordamchi fe'l** qoladi.
Gapda yordamchi fe'l bo'lsa (am/is/are, was/were, have/has, can, will, might ...) — o'sha qaytariladi.
Yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmasa (Present Simple, Past Simple darak gapi) — **do / does / did**.
Darak qisqa javob qisqartirilmaydi: Yes, I **am**. / Yes, she **is**. Inkor — qisqa: No, I**'m not**. / No, she **isn't**.
Taqqoslash: I'm not, but my sister **is**. / She likes it, but I **don't**.

examples.title: Short answers with **be**: Yes, I **am** / No, it **isn't**
examples.description: **be** bilan berilgan savolga qisqa javob: Yes + olmosh + **am / is / are / was / were**; No + olmosh + **'m not / isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't**. Asosiy so'z (hungry, at home) takrorlanmaydi.

sentences.text: Are you hungry? — Yes, **I am**.
sentences.translation: Qorningiz ochmi? — Ha, **och**.

sentences.text: Is your brother at home now? — No, **he isn't**.
sentences.translation: Akangiz hozir uydami? — Yo'q, **uyda emas**.

sentences.text: Are the shops open on Sunday? — Yes, **they are**.
sentences.translation: Do'konlar yakshanba kuni ochiqmi? — Ha, **ochiq**.

sentences.text: Was the film interesting? — No, **it wasn't**, so we left early.
sentences.translation: Film qiziq bo'ldimi? — Yo'q, **qiziq emasdi**, shuning uchun erta chiqib ketdik.

sentences.text: Were your parents in Bukhara last week? — Yes, **they were**.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz o'tgan hafta Buxoroda edimi? — Ha, **Buxoroda edi**.

sentences.text: Is Madina still a student? — No, **she isn't**. She's a nurse now.
sentences.translation: Madina hali ham talabami? — Yo'q, **talaba emas**. U endi hamshira.

sentences.text: Am I late? — No, **you aren't**. The meeting starts at ten.
sentences.translation: Kechikdimmi? — Yo'q, **kechikmadingiz**. Yig'ilish soat o'nda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Is it cold in Tashkent in January? — Yes, **it is**, especially at night.
sentences.translation: Yanvarda Toshkentda sovuq bo'ladimi? — Ha, **bo'ladi**, ayniqsa kechasi.

sentences.text: Were you tired after the trip? — Yes, **I was**, but only a little.
sentences.translation: Safardan keyin charchadingizmi? — Ha, **charchadim**, lekin ozgina.

sentences.text: Are Tom and Emma from London? — No, **they aren't**. They're from Oxford.
sentences.translation: Tom va Emma Londondanmi? — Yo'q, **Londondan emas**. Ular Oksforddan.

examples.title: Short answers with **do / does / did**
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple savollariga javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi, uning o'rniga **do / does / did** (inkorda **don't / doesn't / didn't**) keladi.

sentences.text: Do you like spicy food? — Yes, **I do**.
sentences.translation: Achchiq taomni yoqtirasizmi? — Ha, **yoqtiraman**.

sentences.text: Does Bekzod play football? — No, **he doesn't**. He prefers tennis.
sentences.translation: Bekzod futbol o'ynaydimi? — Yo'q, **o'ynamaydi**. U tennisni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: Did you see the match last night? — Yes, **I did**.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun o'yinni ko'rdingizmi? — Ha, **ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: Does this bus go to the station? — Yes, **it does**.
sentences.translation: Bu avtobus vokzalga boradimi? — Ha, **boradi**.

sentences.text: Did Sarah call you yesterday? — No, **she didn't**, and I'm a bit worried.
sentences.translation: Kecha Sara sizga qo'ng'iroq qildimi? — Yo'q, **qilmadi**, men biroz xavotirdaman.

sentences.text: Do your grandparents live with you? — No, **they don't**. They live in a village.
sentences.translation: Bobo-buvingiz siz bilan yashaydimi? — Yo'q, **yashamaydi**. Ular qishloqda turishadi.

sentences.text: Where's Aziz? Did he go home? — Yes, **he did**, about an hour ago.
sentences.translation: Aziz qani? Uyga ketdimi? — Ha, **ketdi**, taxminan bir soat oldin.

sentences.text: Does it often rain in Manchester? — Yes, **it does**, almost every week.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda tez-tez yomg'ir yog'adimi? — Ha, **yog'adi**, deyarli har hafta.

sentences.text: Did the children enjoy the zoo? — **They did**. They want to go again.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga hayvonot bog'i yoqdimi? — **Yoqdi**. Yana borishni xohlashyapti.

sentences.text: Do you know Emma's phone number? — Sorry, **I don't**.
sentences.translation: Emmaning telefon raqamini bilasizmi? — Kechirasiz, **bilmayman**.

examples.title: Short answers: **have**, **can**, **will** and others
examples.description: Savolda qaysi yordamchi yoki modal fe'l bo'lsa, javobda ham o'sha: Have you ...? — Yes, I **have**. Can she ...? — No, she **can't**. Javobda **might** («balki») ham kelishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Have you finished your homework? — Yes, **I have**.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifangizni tugatdingizmi? — Ha, **tugatdim**.

sentences.text: Can your sister drive? — No, **she can't**, but she's learning.
sentences.translation: Opangiz mashina hayday oladimi? — Yo'q, **hayday olmaydi**, lekin o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Will you be in the office on Saturday morning? — Yes, **I will**.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni ertalab ofisda bo'lasizmi? — Ha, **bo'laman**.

sentences.text: Has James ever been to Uzbekistan? — No, **he hasn't**, but he wants to go.
sentences.translation: Jeyms hech O'zbekistonda bo'lganmi? — Yo'q, **bo'lmagan**, lekin borishni xohlaydi.

sentences.text: Can I pay by card here? — Yes, of course **you can**.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda karta bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi? — Ha, albatta **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Should we take an umbrella? — Yes, **we should**. It looks like rain.
sentences.translation: Soyabon olaylikmi? — Ha, **olganimiz ma'qul**. Yomg'ir yog'adiganga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: Will the train be late again? — I hope not, but **it might**.
sentences.translation: Poyezd yana kechikadimi? — Umid qilamanki, yo'q, lekin **kechikishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Have the guests arrived yet? — No, **they haven't**. They're stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar keldimi? — Yo'q, hali **kelishmadi**. Ular tirbandlikda qolib ketishgan.

sentences.text: Is Madina coming to the party? — **She might**. She isn't sure yet.
sentences.translation: Madina ziyofatga keladimi? — **Kelishi mumkin**. U hali aniq bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Could you help me with these bags? — Sorry, **I can't** at the moment.
sentences.translation: Sumkalarni ko'tarishib yuborolmaysizmi? — Kechirasiz, hozir **qo'limdan kelmaydi**.

examples.title: **I'm not** ..., but my sister **is**
examples.description: Ikki kishini taqqoslash: birinchi qism to'liq gap, ikkinchi qismda faqat ega va **be** (is, aren't, was, wasn't). Gap oxiridagi darak **is** qisqartirilmaydi: but she **is** («but she's» emas).

sentences.text: I'm not hungry, but Madina **is**.
sentences.translation: Men och emasman, Madina esa **och**.

sentences.text: Tom isn't at work today, but his manager **is**.
sentences.translation: Tom bugun ishda emas, rahbari esa **ishda**.

sentences.text: My brother is very tall, but **I'm not**.
sentences.translation: Akam juda baland bo'yli, men esa **unday emasman**.

sentences.text: The first exam was easy, but the second one **wasn't**.
sentences.translation: Birinchi imtihon oson edi, ikkinchisi esa **oson emasdi**.

sentences.text: We weren't at the wedding, but our parents **were**.
sentences.translation: Biz to'yda bo'lmadik, ota-onamiz esa **bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: Are you ready? — **I am**, but Aziz **isn't**. He's still in the shower.
sentences.translation: Tayyormisizlar? — Men **tayyorman**, Aziz esa **tayyor emas**. U hali dushda.

sentences.text: Most of the rooms are clean, but this one **isn't**.
sentences.translation: Xonalarning ko'pi toza, bu xona esa **toza emas**.

sentences.text: In summer Samarkand is hot, but the mountains **aren't**.
sentences.translation: Yozda Samarqand issiq bo'ladi, tog'larda esa **unday emas**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza wasn't nervous before the interview, but her friend **was**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza suhbat oldidan hayajonlanmadi, dugonasi esa **hayajonlandi**.

sentences.text: Everyone thinks the hotel is expensive, but it really **isn't**.
sentences.translation: Hamma mehmonxonani qimmat deb o'ylaydi, aslida esa u **qimmat emas**.

examples.title: I **don't**, but Tom **does**
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple da asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi: uning o'rnida **do / does / did** yoki **don't / doesn't / didn't**. I don't like tea, but my wife **does** (= likes tea).

sentences.text: I don't eat meat, but my husband **does**.
sentences.translation: Men go'sht yemayman, erim esa **yeydi**.

sentences.text: Sarah speaks French, but her brother **doesn't**.
sentences.translation: Sara fransuzcha gapiradi, akasi esa **gapirmaydi**.

sentences.text: We didn't go to the concert, but our friends **did**.
sentences.translation: Biz konsertga bormadik, do'stlarimiz esa **borishdi**.

sentences.text: My father drinks black tea, but my mother **doesn't**. She prefers green tea.
sentences.translation: Otam qora choy ichadi, onam esa **ichmaydi**. U ko'k choyni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Who wants more plov? — **I do**! It's delicious.
sentences.translation: Kim yana palov xohlaydi? — **Men**! Juda mazali ekan.

sentences.text: Bekzod didn't pass the driving test, but his sister **did**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod haydovchilik imtihonidan o'ta olmadi, singlisi esa **o'tdi**.

sentences.text: Not many people in our office drive to work, but James **does**.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizda ishga mashinada keladiganlar kam, Jeyms esa **mashinada keladi**.

sentences.text: My children love snow, but **I don't**. I prefer summer.
sentences.translation: Bolalarim qorni juda yaxshi ko'radi, men esa **yoqtirmayman**. Menga yoz yoqadi.

sentences.text: Last spring it rained a lot in Tashkent, but this spring **it didn't**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan bahor Toshkentda yomg'ir ko'p yog'di, bu bahor esa **yog'madi**.

sentences.text: I don't remember his name, but maybe Dilnoza **does**.
sentences.translation: Uning ismini eslay olmayapman, balki Dilnoza **eslar**.

examples.title: **can't**, **hasn't**, **won't**: other auxiliaries
examples.description: Yordamchi va modal fe'llar ham shunday ishlaydi: I can't swim, but my son **can**. Ikkinchi qismdagi fe'l birinchi qismning zamoni va shakliga mos keladi.

sentences.text: I can't swim, but my little son **can**.
sentences.translation: Men suzishni bilmayman, kichkina o'g'lim esa **biladi**.

sentences.text: Aziz has been to London, but his wife **hasn't**.
sentences.translation: Aziz Londonda bo'lgan, xotini esa **bo'lmagan**.

sentences.text: I haven't read this book yet, but Madina **has**.
sentences.translation: Men bu kitobni hali o'qimaganman, Madina esa **o'qigan**.

sentences.text: Tom will be at the meeting, but **I won't**. I'm on holiday next week.
sentences.translation: Tom yig'ilishda bo'ladi, men esa **bo'lmayman**. Kelasi hafta ta'tildaman.

sentences.text: My grandmother can't use a smartphone, but my grandfather **can**.
sentences.translation: Buvim smartfondan foydalana olmaydi, bobom esa **foydalana oladi**.

sentences.text: Most of my friends have got a car, but **I haven't**.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimning ko'pida mashina bor, menda esa **yo'q**.

sentences.text: You don't have to come with us, but you **can** if you want.
sentences.translation: Biz bilan borishingiz shart emas, lekin xohlasangiz **borishingiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: I'd like to help you, but **I can't** — I'm very busy today.
sentences.translation: Sizga yordam bergim keladi, lekin **qo'limdan kelmaydi** — bugun juda bandman.

sentences.text: Sarah might come to dinner tonight, but James **won't**. He's working late.
sentences.translation: Sara bugun kechki ovqatga kelishi mumkin, Jeyms esa **kelmaydi**. U kechgacha ishlaydi.

sentences.text: My old phone could take good photos, but this new one **can't**.
sentences.translation: Eski telefonim yaxshi surat ola olardi, bu yangisi esa **ola olmaydi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a new flatmate
examples.description: Yangi kvartiradosh bilan tanishuv: savollar va qisqa javoblar (I am. / I do. / I haven't, but James has.). Javoblarda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentences.text: — Hi, I'm Tom. **Are you** the new student from Uzbekistan?
sentences.translation: — Salom, men Tom. O'zbekistondan kelgan yangi talaba **sizmisiz**?

sentences.text: — Yes, **I am**. My name's Aziz, and I'm from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **menman**. Ismim Aziz, Samarqanddanman.

sentences.text: — Nice to meet you. **Do you** cook much at home?
sentences.translation: — Tanishganimdan xursandman. Uyda ko'p ovqat **pishirasizmi**?

sentences.text: — **I do**, actually. I make plov almost every weekend.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **pishiraman**. Deyarli har dam olish kuni palov qilaman.

sentences.text: — Lucky me! **I don't**, so maybe you can teach me.
sentences.translation: — Omadim bor ekan! Men esa **pishirmayman**, balki menga o'rgatarsiz.

sentences.text: — Of course. **Have you** got a bike? The university is quite far.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Velosipedingiz **bormi**? Universitet ancha uzoqda.

sentences.text: — No, **I haven't**, but my friend James **has**. He can lend me his.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, menda **yo'q**, lekin do'stim Jeymsda **bor**. U menga o'zinikini berib turadi.

sentences.text: — Good. By the way, **does** loud music bother you?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Aytgancha, baland musiqa sizga **xalaqit beradimi**?

sentences.text: — No, **it doesn't**. I can sleep through anything!
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **xalaqit bermaydi**. Men har qanday shovqinda uxlay olaman!

sentences.text: — Brilliant. My last flatmate didn't like music, but **I do**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Oldingi kvartiradoshim musiqani yoqtirmasdi, men esa **yoqtiraman**.

examples.title: Mixed practice: short answers and contrasts
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: turli zamonlarda qisqa javob va taqqoslash. Har gal o'zingizdan so'rang: savolda yoki birinchi qismda qaysi yordamchi fe'l bor?

sentences.text: Is Dilnoza coming with us? — Yes, **she is**. She's waiting downstairs.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza biz bilan boryaptimi? — Ha, **boryapti**. U pastda kutyapti.

sentences.text: James was born in Oxford, but his parents **weren't**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Oksfordda tug'ilgan, ota-onasi esa **u yerda tug'ilmagan**.

sentences.text: Did you lock the door? — **I think I did**, but I'll check.
sentences.translation: Eshikni qulfladingizmi? — **Qulflagan bo'lsam kerak**, lekin tekshirib ko'raman.

sentences.text: Were you sleeping when I phoned? — No, **I wasn't**. I was cooking dinner.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilganimda uxlayotganmidingiz? — Yo'q, **uxlamayotgan edim**. Kechki ovqat pishirayotgan edim.

sentences.text: My sister has already seen the new film, but **I haven't** yet.
sentences.translation: Singlim yangi filmni allaqachon ko'rgan, men esa hali **ko'rmaganman**.

sentences.text: Has the post arrived? — Yes, **it has**. There's a letter for you.
sentences.translation: Pochta keldimi? — Ha, **keldi**. Sizga xat bor.

sentences.text: Bekzod isn't going to the gym today, but his brother **is**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bugun sport zaliga bormayapti, akasi esa **boryapti**.

sentences.text: Can Emma speak Uzbek? — **She can**, a little. She learnt it in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Emma o'zbekcha gapira oladimi? — Ozgina **gapira oladi**. U Toshkentda o'rgangan.

sentences.text: These shoes were cheap, but the jacket **wasn't**.
sentences.translation: Bu tufli arzon edi, kurtka esa **arzon emasdi**.

sentences.text: Will you need the car tomorrow? — **I might**. I'll tell you tonight.
sentences.translation: Ertaga sizga mashina kerak bo'ladimi? — **Kerak bo'lishi mumkin**. Bugun kechqurun aytaman.
